name: Web Content Type Classifier API
shortDescription: Resolve a URL/filename/extension/MIME to a canonical content category, MIME, and agent handling
description: Agent-native content-type classifier driven by lookup tables — no fetch, no LLM. /classify takes any of a URL, filename, extension, or MIME (Content-Type) string and resolves a canonical category (image, video, audio, pdf, document, spreadsheet, presentation, archive, code, data, webpage, feed, font, executable, text), the canonical MIME, binary-vs-text nature, the deciding signal, and the typical way an agent should handle that type. The one-call /lookup adds reasoning and downstream handling guidance. Deterministic, confidence 1.0, never times out.
